summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the availability and proper use of a STAGE dataset, specifically whether it is needed for comparison when launching in new countries or developing models. It was confirmed that while model training occurs using a stage dataset (from `stage_ml`), the final dataset used for release must be from production. A decision was made to retain the stage dataset starting from 2021 and clean up older data.
decisions: The stage dataset will be retained starting from 2021.
